rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In his opening remarks to the National Executive on 11 April 1998 the speaker (named in the page heading only as 'Advani') says 'All the formalities of electing the new president will soon be over, and the Party's unanimous-but by no means anonymous-choice will be declared next week'; the new president is not named.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same remarks the speaker calls the meeting 'the last full-fledged meeting of the National Executive during my tenure as the Party president' and says 'I, as the outgoing president, pledge my fullest support and co-operation to my successor'.
